prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 研发中心季度例会签到表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "姓名" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "部门" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 3: header "签到时间" · longest unbreakable word 42px · one-line width 62px
  col 4: header "签退时间" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 62px
  col 5: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 429px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"记录研发中心季度例会的参会人员、所属部门、签到签退时间及特殊情况。","reading":"按行核对个人出勤情况，纵向查看部门和时间；备注用于解释缺席签退或迟到等情况。较长备注形成的行高可容纳同一行部门名称的换行。","groups":["姓名与部门共同识别参会人员及其归属。","签到时间与签退时间是一对对应字段，宜采用相同宽度以便比较。","备注是补充说明，内容长度变化较大。"],"keep_intact":["姓名","签到和签退的具体时间","表示无记录的破折号"],"may_wrap":["部门名称可在汉字之间换行。","签到时间和签退时间的表头可换行。","备注可按语义自然换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [67, 73, 63, 63, 93] · table 360×733px · row heights [60, 60, 176, 83, 60, 60, 176, 60] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [67, 69, 63, 63, 97] · table 360×733px · row heights [60, 60, 176, 83, 60, 60, 176, 60] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [67, 69, 83, 83, 57] · table 360×1058px · row heights [36, 60, 339, 129, 60, 60, 315, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 14 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"姓名和具体时间保持完整；两列时间等宽，便于横向核对。部门换行与备注造成的行高相互容纳，长备注仍有基本的阅读节奏。","problems":"时间表头分成两行；备注列偏窄，长说明断成许多短行，造成较高的行和大量空白。部门名称也普遍换行。","cause":"两列时间各63px，仅容纳42px文本；备注93px仅容纳72px文本。部门73px不足以容纳最长的77px单行内容。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"保留了姓名、时间的完整性和时间列等宽的对应关系；备注比r1A略宽。","problems":"整体行高和长备注的七行高度与r1A相同，备注宽度增加尚未带来可见的高度改善；部门仍普遍换行，时间表头仍为两行。","cause":"备注从93px增至97px仍不足以改变最长单元格的行数；部门缩至69px，时间列仍各为63px。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"两个时间表头和具体时间均完整单行显示，成对字段清楚；姓名也保持完整。","problems":"备注被压成极窄的文字带，长说明多达14行，阅读断续，表格大幅增高，其他列随之出现大片空白，行与行之间的核对变得吃力。","cause":"时间列各增至83px以容纳完整表头，挤占了备注列；备注仅57px，扣除边距和边框后只有36px文本宽度。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"备注优先","widths":[67,69,63,63,97],"change":"以r1B为基准，保持时间成对等宽和姓名完整，作为后续比较的参照。"},{"name":"扩大备注","widths":[67,62,63,63,104],"change":"将部门缩至62px，把7px让给备注；部门仍可在汉字间换行，检验更宽的备注能否减少长行高度。"},{"name":"单行部门","widths":[67,98,63,63,68],"change":"让部门达到单行所需的98px，保持时间等宽，检验部门整齐单行是否值得备注变窄带来的代价。"}]}
